summary: Frontend-only retest of the Cycle Coach Phase Predictor fixes (adv_active@test.com; 1920x1080, 390x844, 1920x800). All requested items PASS. (1) Delete-refresh bug FIXED: logged Oct 11 and Nov 8 (today is Nov 10, 2026). The phase card showed Day 3 / Phase 1: Day 3 (Menstrual). After deleting the Nov 8 entry, the card updated without a reload to Day 31 / Phase 5: Day 7 (Late Luteal/PMS) and the Cycle Extended banner appeared. After a reload the values were the same. (2) Coaching Manual: 'Basal Body Temperature (BBT)' and 'Ovulation Predictor Kits (OPKs)' each appear exactly once, and each data-testid appears once. The Luteal Phase term contains 'after ovulation', 'before the next period', '12–14 days', '11–17 days' and 'estimate'. The optional note is shown. (3) Bleeding duration: the section is between Log New Period (y=440) and Recent Cycles (y=726). Its container (rgba(15,23,42,0.6) with a 1px slate-700 border) stands out against the dialog (rgb(30,41,59)). Each step changes the value by 1; minus is disabled at 3 and plus at 7. The value stays at 6 after a reload. A pre-set lutealConstant:13 is kept after a + click. The phase card updates live. (4) /predictor: no Advanced Settings and no setting-menstrual-length / setting-luteal-constant; the menstrual range is 'Days 1–6' at 6. (5) No horizontal overflow at 390x844 or 1920x800 in the dashboard/manual or the dialog. No billing actions were taken.

ui_bugs.issue: The same start date can be logged twice. Logging 10/11/2026 when it was already in the history (created by partner setup) added a second 10/11/2026 row stuck on 'Calculating...'. There is no duplicate-date check in handleLogPeriod or LocalStorage.addCycleEntry.

ui_bugs.component: Dashboard handleLogPeriod (code review, not reproduced in UTC browser)
ui_bugs.issue: new Date(logPeriodDate) parses 'YYYY-MM-DD' as UTC midnight, but 'today' is local midnight. For users east of UTC (UTC+1 and later), logging today's date gives a false 'Cannot log a future date' error. Parse the date as local (as date-picker parseLocal does).

issues: Cycle Phases still lists 'Luteal Phase (Days 17–23, roughly)' and 'Menstrual Phase (Days 1–5, roughly)'. This is a minor mismatch with the new Luteal definition (12–14 days, ending before the period) and with the user's saved bleeding duration. Consider a note that PMS is the late part of the luteal phase.

action_items: Optional: block or merge duplicate period start dates in handleLogPeriod
Optional: parse logPeriodDate as local time in the future-date check (timezone bug for UTC+ users)
critical_code_review_comments: handleDeleteCycle: if the last remaining cycle is deleted, the partner profile cycleStartDate is not cleared, so the phase card keeps using it (edge case, not tested)
handleLogPeriod leaves console.log debug statements in
seed_data_creation: Only browser localStorage (cleared on each run): partner TEST_Partner and cycle entries. No server data changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation run starts with fresh localStorage. Onboarding: state-privacy-waiver combobox -> 'Outside the United States' -> privacy-continue-btn -> both consent checkboxes -> consent-continue-btn -> partner-name-input + cycle-start-date-input (button[name=day]; nav button[name=previous-month]) -> create-partner-button. Partner setup creates a cycle-history entry itself. Cycle settings key: cyclecoach_cycle_settings_<uid> (plain JSON). Delete uses window.confirm. Browser date = Nov 10, 2026.
